question.text: What color will the 2027 Pantone Color of the Year be?
question.resolution_criteria:
This question will resolve based on Pantone's Color Of The Year for 2027. Specifically, the color's hex code will be converted to the Oklch Color Space and the question will resolve based on the following criteria:

If Chroma is ≤0.007, then
Black if Lightness is ≤0.15.
Gray if Lightness is >0.15 and \<0.85.
White if Lightness is ≥0.85.

if Chroma is >0.007, then
Brown if Lightness is \<0.65, Chroma is ≤0.12 and Hue is ≥25 and \<80.

if the above isn't met, then
Pink if Lightness is ≥0.55 and (Hue is ≥340 or Hue is \<30).

if the above criteria aren't met, then:
Red if Hue is ≥10 and \<30
Orange if Hue is ≥30 and \<80.
Yellow if Hue is ≥80 and \<110.
Green if Hue is ≥110 and \<175.
Cyan if Hue is ≥175 and \<230.
Blue if Hue is ≥230 and \<270.
Purple if Hue is ≥270 or \<10
question.fine_print:
If Pantone releases multiple Colors Of The Year for 2027, the one used for resolution will be the first color named in their announcement. In 2016, this was Rose Quartz, and in 2021 this was Ultimate Gray.
If Pantone does not announce a Color of the Year during 2026, this question will be annulled.

research:
Pantone has not yet announced its 2027 Color of the Year. The reveal looks set for about December 3, 2026, at a Pantone event in Miami.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-08: Pantone's Color of the Year page still shows only the 2026 color, PANTONE 11-4201 Cloud Dancer, and gives no hex code there. [Pantone 2026](https://www.pantone.com/color-of-the-year/2026)
- 2026-11-08: The main Color of the Year page has a 2027 section headed "Four cities. One unforgettable moment." It lists events in Miami (December 3, Art Basel), Shanghai (December 9), Seoul (December 11) and Mumbai (December 15). No color is named yet. [Pantone COTY](https://www.pantone.com/na/en-us/color-of-the-year)
- The question converts Pantone's published hex code to Oklch. Note that the Manifold market resolves on a different basis, Pantone's own color code, so the two are not exactly the same question.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet, and I found no credible leak.
- 2026-07-28: Laurie Pressman of Pantone declined to give hints. Pantone usually picks the next year's color around April or May, starts partner talks in May or June, and announces in December. So the color is already chosen and partners know it. [Marketing Brew](https://www.marketingbrew.com/stories/pantone-color-of-the-year-tech-pushback)
- Recent announcement dates: December 4, 2025 (Cloud Dancer) and December 5, 2024 (Mocha Mousse). [paletadecolores](https://paletadecolores.org/en/color-of-the-year-2027.html)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-07: Hot Wheels showed four 2027 models in its Pantone Silver Series, one of them blue. This is not a Color of the Year signal. [autoevolution](https://www.autoevolution.com/news/4-new-hot-wheels-coming-to-the-pantone-series-soon-278104.html)
- 2026-11-05/06: Broader trend coverage:
  - Houzz sees a move toward warm beiges and earthy exteriors. [House Beautiful](https://www.housebeautiful.com/design-inspiration/a74346205/curb-appeal-trends-2027/)
  - Interior design is moving away from neutrals toward intense colors. [El Adelantado](https://eladelantado.com/provincia/2026/11/06/las-paredes-recuperan-el-color-los-tonos-intensos-transforman-la-decoracion/)
  - Nail trends include dark chocolate shades. [Zoe Report](https://www.thezoereport.com/beauty/winter-2027-nail-trends)
- Mid-October 2026: Other brands' 2027 Colors of the Year, with the hex codes the site gives:

  - Sherwin-Williams Celery #CBC48C
  - Behr Grounded #6A6943

  Overall they lean toward greens, blues and earthy tones. [paletadecolores](https://paletadecolores.org/en/color-of-the-year-2027.html)
- 2026-03-11/12: At The Inspired Home Show, Pantone's Leatrice Eiseman presented the Pantone View Home + Interiors 2027 forecast, themed "Sense-Abilities" and framed around "calm joy." Named palettes include Delight (muted summer-meadow tones), Hush (muted midtones) and Honest (browns, reds, oranges). [Housewares.org](https://housewares.org/show-press-releases/2027-home-color-forecast/)

## 4. Base rates
I classified past winners under the question's rules from memory, using the commonly cited hex codes and estimating their Oklch values. These are not computed, so check the borderline ones.
- 2026 Cloud Dancer #F0EEE9: White. Chroma is near the 0.007 cutoff, so this could be wrong.
- 2025 Mocha Mousse #A47864: Brown.
- 2024 Peach Fuzz #FFBE98: Orange.
- 2023 Viva Magenta #BB2649: Red, with hue near 10, close to the Purple boundary.
- 2022 Very Peri #6667AB: Purple.
- 2021 Ultimate Gray: Gray, since it was named first.
- 2020 Classic Blue #0F4C81: Blue.
- 2019 Living Coral #FF6F61: Pink, because lightness is at least 0.55 and hue is below 30.
- 2018 Ultra Violet: Purple.
- 2017 Greenery: Green.
- 2016 Rose Quartz: Pink.
- 2015 Marsala: Red.
- 2014 Radiant Orchid: Purple.
- 2013 Emerald: Green.
- 2012 Tangerine Tango: Orange.
- 2011 Honeysuckle: Pink.
- 2010 Turquoise: Cyan.

Tally for 2010 to 2026 (17 years): Purple 3, Pink 3, Red 2, Orange 2, Green 2, and one each for Blue, Cyan, Gray, Brown and White. Yellow has won only once, in 2021 as the second color (Illuminating), which doesn't count here. Black has never won. Pantone rarely repeats a color family in consecutive years. The last two picks were muted or neutral (Brown, then White).

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-11-08: Manifold, "What color will Pantone Color of The Year 2027 be closest to?": Blue 44%, Sandy 6%, Other 6%, Olive 5%, Cyan 5%, White, Pink, Brown and Gray 4% each, Black, Orange, Yellow, Green, Purple and Red 3% each. Its categories and method (Pantone code) differ from this question. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/jknowak/what-color-will-pantone-color-of-th)
- I found no Polymarket or Kalshi market on this. None of the Kalshi markets supplied with the question are relevant.
- WGSN/Coloro's Luminous Blue is a separate forecast, not Pantone's.

## 6. Upcoming events
- About 2026-12-03: The expected reveal, likely tied to the Miami Art Basel event. Pantone has sometimes announced a day or two before its events.
- 2026-12-09 to 12-15: Pantone's Shanghai, Seoul and Mumbai events.
- Before the reveal, watch for leaks through brand partners or retailer listings. I found none so far.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** The reveal is expected around December 3, 2026, about 25 days away. Pantone has almost certainly chosen the color already, and partners know it, but nothing has leaked.

(b) **Status quo:** No color has been announced. The default is the base-rate distribution. Pantone rarely repeats a family in consecutive years, so White (2026) and Brown (2025) are unlikely.

(c) **Base rates (2010-2026, 17 years, by this question's Oklch rules):**
- Purple 3, Pink 3.
- Red 2, Orange 2, Green 2.
- Blue 1, Cyan 1, Gray 1, Brown 1, White 1.
- Yellow 0 as a first-named color, Black 0.

Recent picks have been muted. After two neutrals in a row, a shift toward a more saturated or "joyful" color seems plausible.

(d) **Strongest evidence:**
- Mid-October 2026: other brands' 2027 colors lean blue and green, including WGSN/Coloro Luminous Blue, Valspar and Clark+Kensington light blues, and Webster Green.
- March 2026: Pantone's own 2027 home forecast was framed around "calm joy," with muted meadow tones, midtones and an earthy "Honest" palette.
- November 8: Manifold has Blue at 44%. Its categories differ, it is thinly traded, and it has no leak behind it, so it is only a weak anchor.
- Blue has not been picked since 2020, which makes it "due."
- Designer predictions mention olive, jewel greens and dusty pinks.

**Classification caveats:**
- Teal or turquoise shades land in Cyan.
- Some olives fall into Yellow (hue below 110).
- Dusty pinks or mauves with hue below 30 and lightness of at least 0.55 count as Pink.
- Darker ones fall into Red or Brown.

**How far I moved:** I raised Blue well above its base rate of about 6% to about 26%, but kept it far below Manifold's 44%. Green moves up modestly. White and Brown move down because Pantone avoids repeats.

(e) **Unexpected scenario:** Pantone picks a lavender-lilac, which counts as Purple. Or it picks a warm, joyful coral-pink that reads as Pink or Orange, rejecting the blue consensus. Another possibility is a muted olive with hue just under 110, which would resolve Yellow.
